primaryTextRead.text: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

wikipediaRead.title: Abdi (biblical figure)
wikipediaRead.locator: L101–107 identifies the biblical name and cites 2 Chronicles 29:12 for Kish son of Abdi; it notes the Chronicle references may denote one person, distinct from an Ezra namesake.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The article directly cites the 2 Chronicles 29:12 witness and discusses the possible relation of the two Chronicles references.
